applicabilityBasis.summary: cgUSD is presented as a USD-pegged Treasury-backed token with a fixed $1 quoted unit, rebasing token balances and USDC withdrawal. Yield accrual alone does not make it an appreciating-price vault receipt. The withdrawal FAQ describes Treasury-price risk, potentially reduced claim amounts and a 35 bps fee. The separate redemption mechanics page describes USDC recasting and fees waived during an early promotion, not a permanent absence of withdrawal penalties. Cygnus Information Limited is a verified BVI corporate entity associated with the website and the different CGN token, but no reviewed contract establishes its cgUSD national-currency or deposit redemption obligation. Digital-asset redemption and the unresolved legal obligor leave GENIUS applicability unclear.

genius.issuerDomicile: British Virgin Islands: Cygnus Information Limited, LEI 25490042I90M0EGQ0T03. The issuer-hosted CGN whitepaper and GLEIF establish this entity's registration, not its legal obligations to cgUSD holders. ARKS Labs separately publishes Hong Kong and U.S. operational centres and attributes MSB registration No. 31000226418649 to Arks Foundation.
genius.notes: As of 2026-10-07, Cygnus Information Limited is retained as the existing issuer-associated entity because the website footer, issuer-hosted CGN whitepaper and GLEIF identify it. Its cgUSD legal obligations remain unverified. The CGN whitepaper publication/admission date is 2026-07-28 and relates to the different CGN token; Title II notification is not cgUSD EMT/ART authorization or U.S. qualification. ARKS self-claims subsidiary Arks Foundation FinCEN MSB registration 31000226418649; this was not independently confirmed and does not establish cgUSD prudential licensing. The withdrawal FAQ quotes 5-7 days, a 35 bps fee and possible claim reduction. The separate redemption mechanics page quotes 2-5 days and waives fees during an early promotion. Their publication chronology was not verified; neither is converted into an unconditional par-redemption promise. Reserve/redemption flags record public conceptual disclosures, not verified actual holdings or GENIUS adequacy. No current cgUSD-specific monthly reserve attestation was verified. No qualifying public authorization or foreign-exception registration was identified; the broad U.S. regime is pre-effective, with DASP restrictions assessed separately.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, no public cgUSD/Cygnus/ARKS GENIUS PPSI approval, qualified state status, official application or registered foreign exception was found in the opened regulator materials, OCC table, NYDFS directory and issuer disclosures. The OCC table is not exhaustive and proposed rules do not adjudicate applications. ARKS MSB status is an issuer claim, not a verified prudential license. Foreign-exception status remains unknown because neither a qualifying comparable regime determination nor token-specific registration was identified.
